column1: # German (de) interface catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:
#   context <TAB> English source <TAB> translation
#   context    empty (WordCraft uses no contexts yet)
#   source     the English text exactly as in the code (tl!(...), ribbon labels, command labels)
#   escapes    \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns, and a
#              trailing "…" in one needs one in the other.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
# German (Standard German, neutral across Germany, Austria and Switzerland; `ß` is used, as in
# Germany and Austria). Commands are infinitives (Speichern, Kopieren); second-person text uses du;
# nouns are capitalised as German requires; product and format names stay as they are (WordCraft,
# PDF, Markdown, MCP ...). This catalog format has no plural forms, so counts use count-neutral
# wording (`Wörter: 21`, `Zeilen: 1`) that is grammatical for every number.
# Clean room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label in ordinary
# computing vocabulary. No Microsoft Word (or other product) localisation, string table or
# translated UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
# Terminology: Font = Schriftart, Font Size = Schriftgrad, Paragraph = Absatz, Style = Formatvorlage,
# Review = Überprüfen, References = Verweise, Track Changes = Änderungen nachverfolgen,
# Header/Footer = Kopfzeile/Fußzeile, Caption = Beschriftung, Citation = Zitat, Bibliography =
# Literaturverzeichnis, Mail Merge = Serienbrief, Equation = Gleichung, Page {page} of {pages} =
# Seite {page} von {pages}.
